title: AARQ user-information analogue near ACSE tag-sensitive path
purpose: Enter ACSE AARQ parsing with compact but complete BER fields including user-information, keeping tag and length relations valid while remaining close to historically sensitive ACSE parsing surfaces.
expected_behavior: A receiver should accept the COTP connection request framing and then parse a compact AARQ-like ACSE message containing nested user-information and MMS context identifiers.
constraints_preserved: TPKT total length is 45 bytes and matches the encoded frame.
COTP CR parameter structure is syntactically complete.
ACSE message type is 0x60 and user-information tag 0xbe uses definite length.
MMS context identifier uses documented 02 01 value encoding shape.
All BER lengths are repaired to be consistent.
issue_safety_notes: This keeps near ACSE tag-handling parser space without reusing malformed AARQ crash bytes or underflowing tag scans.
